data.label: Customer Trust
data.title:
5 things customers check
*before calling you*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site passes.

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Is it *mobile friendly*?
data.body: Most customers search for services on their phones. If your site is hard to read on a mobile screen, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and test every button.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title:
Can they find your
*contact info*?
data.body: If a customer has to hunt for your number, they’ll get frustrated. Make it the first thing they see.
data.fix: Fix: Put your phone number in the top right corner.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Do you show *social proof*?
data.body: People want to know you do good work. Real photos of your jobs or honest reviews build instant trust.
data.fix: Fix: Add three recent customer testimonials to your homepage.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Are your *hours current*?
data.body: Nothing loses a customer faster than showing up when you are closed. Keep your business hours accurate at all times.
data.fix: Fix: Update your hours in your website footer today.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Is your *service list* clear?
data.body: Customers need to know exactly what you do. Don't make them guess if you offer the specific service they need.
data.fix: Fix: List your top three services clearly on the homepage.
